purpose.zh: 拉伸臀部深处，缓解髋部发紧
purpose.en: Stretch deep in your glutes and ease tight hips.

text.zh: 脚踝搭在另一条腿的大腿上，膝盖往外打开
text.en: Cross your ankle over your other thigh and let the knee fall open

text.zh: 仰躺，踩地的脚往臀部挪一点，头和肩膀放松。
text.en: Lie on your back, walk the planted foot closer, and relax your head and shoulders.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your head and tensing your shoulders.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.
